messages.text: How do changes in radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

### Supported facts
ISAC integrates sensing capability into communications networks, and its challenges include high bandwidth, radar equation, power density, spectrum coexistence, and waveform design [36].
MFSS may evolve toward joint waveforms such as communications plus radar sensing [38].
AREG800A is an automotive radar echo generator whose echo generator type is dynamic artificial object generation [1].
AREG800A uses a hybrid concept with analog stepped delay line for short object distances below 17 m and fully digital implementation up to 3000 m [1].
AREG800A also has a digital FMCW concept whose minimum generated distance is the radar-under-test air gap value and whose maximum generated distance is 3000 m [1].
Supported radar frontend capability spans 24.0 GHz to 24.25 GHz with 250 MHz instantaneous bandwidth [3].
AREG800A artificial objects can reach up to 32 objects with listed conventional frontends, with up to 8 objects per frontend [5].
AREG800A object distance accuracy with the R&S AREG8-B9 option is ±5 cm, and object distance step size is 1 cm [5].
AREG800A supports individual Doppler frequency shift per artificial object, with ±500 km/h velocity setting range and 0.001 km/h velocity step size with R&S AREG8-B9 and R&S AREG8-B63 [11].
AREG8-K740 provides an AUX IF output port for radar signal analysis and EIRP measurements [8].
AREG8-K741 provides an AUX IF input port for superimposing interferers [8].
### Implications for signaling test instruments
CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [16].
CMX500 provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [15].
CMX500 signaling options include WLAN signaling, LTE signaling, NR signaling, carrier aggregation, RedCap, eRedCap, NTN, and NB-NTN options [20][22].
MVG integrations use CMX500 OBT for 5G NR, LTE, and WLAN OTA signaling testing, including Wi-Fi 7 in the WLAN integration context [40].
### Implications for non-signaling / radar-focused instruments
CMW290 is a functional radio communication tester [54].
CMW290-supported test areas include GSM, NB-IoT, WCDMA, LTE, TD-SCDMA, CDMA2000, and NR Sub-6GHz mobile station testing [51].
CMW290 software options include RF spectrum analyzer, waveform, analyzer, and signaling options for the listed radio communication technologies [52].
AREG800A is automotive radar echo generation equipment, and the cited source states that it is not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer [9].
AREG800A production configurations range from one digital channel to three digital channels, with one object per channel in the listed production configurations [2].
### Inference lines
【推論】As sensing is integrated into communications networks and joint communications-plus-radar waveforms are considered, a signaling tester would need to remain responsible for communication signaling while radar-specific range, object, Doppler, and interference behavior would need a radar echo-generation capability rather than only protocol signaling [36][38][15][1][5][8][11].
【推論】As radar validation requires dynamic artificial objects, long range to 3000 m, near-object behavior, Doppler, EIRP analysis, and interferer injection, a radar-focused non-signaling setup would need echo generation plus IF input/output capabilities rather than only a conventional communication tester [1][5][8][11].

passages.text:
R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

R&S AREG800A › Automotive radar production configurations
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- [[R&S AREG-P1]] radar mini configuration / [[R&S AREG-DBP1]] base unit option：one digital channel，one object per channel，5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth，near object range possibility，analog IF output interfaces，remote control interfaces，[[R&S AREG-MFP]] / [[R&S AREG-BFP]] frontend option one frontend per channel required。
- [[R&S AREG-P2]] radar golden configuration / [[R&S AREG-DBP2]] base unit option：two digital channels。
- [[R&S AREG-P3]] radar pro configuration / [[R&S AREG-DBP3]] base unit option：搭配 [[R&S AREG-MFP]] / [[R&S AREG-BFP]] frontend option；frontend 支援 monostatic 或 bistatic；three digital channels；one object per channel。

R&S AREG800A › R&S AREG8-24S / R&S AREG8-24D
- RF frequency range：`24.0 GHz to 24.25 GHz`。
- RF instantaneous bandwidth：`250 MHz`。
- IF center frequency：`825 MHz for 250 MHz bandwidth`。
- Maximum number supported：`4`；one IF path per [[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] option required。
- Absolute maximum RX power at frontend：`0 dBm (nom.)`。
- Maximum TX power at frontend：`≥ 15 dBm (meas.)`。
- RF transfer characteristics measurement conditions：with diplexer between RX and TX，frequency step size `2.5 MHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 kHz`，window function normal gate（Hann），type bandpass filter。

6G NTN 展望 › Multi-function satellite services（MFSS）
[[MFSS]] 是將 communications、navigation、earth observation、monitoring、sensing 等 satellite services 整合的概念。

- Phase 1：同一 satellite 整合多個獨立 hardware / services。
- Phase 2：可能整合 joint waveform，例如 communications + radar sensing，或 communications method 提供 timing information。

6G NTN 展望 › Two-stage network access model
來源引述 [[6G-TakeOff]] 提出 UE network access 的 two-stage model：

| Stage | 功能 |
|---|---|
| Anchor part | 提供 downlink synchronization signals、system information、uplink random access；適合 camping、first access、initial connectivity。 |
| Dynamic part | 由 non-permanently visible dynamic cells 組成；較適合 connected mode，UE initial access 後由 network handover 到 dynamic node。 |

此模型的動機是降低 UE 在 idle mode 長時間掃描 dynamic network nodes 的 power consumption。

### Supported facts
ISAC integrates sensing capability into communications networks, and its challenges include high bandwidth, radar equation, power density, spectrum coexistence, and waveform design [36].
MFSS may evolve toward joint waveforms such as communications plus radar sensing [38].
AREG800A is an automotive radar echo generator whose echo generator type is dynamic artificial object generation [1].
AREG800A uses a hybrid concept with analog stepped delay line for short object distances below 17 m and fully digital implementation up to 3000 m [1].
AREG800A also has a digital FMCW concept whose minimum generated distance is the radar-under-test air gap value and whose maximum generated distance is 3000 m [1].
Supported radar frontend capability spans 24.0 GHz to 24.25 GHz with 250 MHz instantaneous bandwidth [3].
AREG800A artificial objects can reach up to 32 objects with listed conventional frontends, with up to 8 objects per frontend [5].
AREG800A object distance accuracy with the R&S AREG8-B9 option is ±5 cm, and object distance step size is 1 cm [5].
AREG800A supports individual Doppler frequency shift per artificial object, with ±500 km/h velocity setting range and 0.001 km/h velocity step size with R&S AREG8-B9 and R&S AREG8-B63 [11].
AREG8-K740 provides an AUX IF output port for radar signal analysis and EIRP measurements [8].
AREG8-K741 provides an AUX IF input port for superimposing interferers [8].
### Implications for signaling test instruments
CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [16].
CMX500 provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [15].
CMX500 signaling options include WLAN signaling, LTE signaling, NR signaling, carrier aggregation, RedCap, eRedCap, NTN, and NB-NTN options [20][22].
MVG integrations use CMX500 OBT for 5G NR, LTE, and WLAN OTA signaling testing, including Wi-Fi 7 in the WLAN integration context [40].
### Implications for non-signaling / radar-focused instruments
CMW290 is a functional radio communication tester [54].
CMW290-supported test areas include GSM, NB-IoT, WCDMA, LTE, TD-SCDMA, CDMA2000, and NR Sub-6GHz mobile station testing [51].
CMW290 software options include RF spectrum analyzer, waveform, analyzer, and signaling options for the listed radio communication technologies [52].
AREG800A is automotive radar echo generation equipment, and the cited source states that it is not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer [9].
AREG800A production configurations range from one digital channel to three digital channels, with one object per channel in the listed production configurations [2].
### Inference lines
【推論】As sensing is integrated into communications networks and joint communications-plus-radar waveforms are considered, a signaling tester would need to remain responsible for communication signaling while radar-specific range, object, Doppler, and interference behavior would need a radar echo-generation capability rather than only protocol signaling [36][38][15][1][5][8][11].
【推論】As radar validation requires dynamic artificial objects, long range to 3000 m, near-object behavior, Doppler, EIRP analysis, and interferer injection, a radar-focused non-signaling setup would need echo generation plus IF input/output capabilities rather than only a conventional communication tester [1][5][8][11].

6G NTN 展望 › ISAC
[[ISAC]] 將 sensing capability 整合進 communications network。

- satellite sensing 可為 active / passive、imaging / non-imaging、monostatic / bistatic / multistatic。
- ISAC 可能支援 drones、transportation、refrigerated logistics、rural sensing 等 multi-operator collaboration use cases。
- challenge 包含 high bandwidth、radar equation、power density、spectrum coexistence 與 waveform design。

6G NTN 展望 › Multi-function satellite services（MFSS）
[[MFSS]] 是將 communications、navigation、earth observation、monitoring、sensing 等 satellite services 整合的概念。

- Phase 1：同一 satellite 整合多個獨立 hardware / services。
- Phase 2：可能整合 joint waveform，例如 communications + radar sensing，或 communications method 提供 timing information。

MVG › CMX500 OBT / WaveStudio 整合
依 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]]：

- [[MVG]] 已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 使用者可透過 [[MVG]] antenna measurement systems 直接執行 [[5G NR]] 與 [[LTE]] OTA signaling testing。
- 與 [[MVG]] multi-probe measurement systems 搭配時，可在 real-world conditions 下進行 OTA testing。
- 整合後支援 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）mode、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD）signaling testing。
- [[Pierre Jurek]] 表示，[[MVG]] 決定支援 different OBT configurations，並正快速擴充到 WiFi technologies，尤其是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。

依 [[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]]：

- [[MVG]] 已將 full [[WLAN]] signaling test functionality including [[Wi-Fi 7]] of the [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 來源稱此整合讓 manufacturers 可在 single antenna measurement system 中執行 comprehensive 4G、5G 與 [[WLAN]] [[OTA testing]]。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合 full Wi‑Fi（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）access point and station testing functionality。
- Software now supports [[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（[[EN-DC]]）testing with the [[R&S CMX500]]。
- [[MVG]] multiprobe measurement systems 被描述為 fully support Wi‑Fi and cellular standards，包括 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD），all within a single tester。
